description: This file defines a Java interface named LogNode, which is part of a logging system that allows different components to output and potentially filter log messages. The interface declares a method 'println' meant for printing log data, with parameters for log level, tag, message, and optional exception.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a logging component capable of outputting log messages, possibly to various targets or with filtering capabilities.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method for instructing the log node to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.
